m. (-रः)
A hyena.
E.
युयुक् joined, खुर a hoof.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Wishing to join or unite.
2 Devout, wishing to effect spiritual union with the divine essence.
E.
युज to be devout or to join, desid. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-त्सा)
Wish or purpose to fight, enmity, pugnacity.
E.
युध to fight, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cowardly, having no intention to fight.
E.
युयुत्सा, and रहित void of.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing or ready to make war or fight, pugnacious, hostile, ambitious.
m. (-त्सुः)
A combatant.
E.
युध to make war, desid. v., उ aff.
